title: Native relation inventory
requirement: WHEN the interpreter is connected to the native backend, the integration SHALL identify each model transition and its circuit/host/native consumer.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Fixed relation across programs
scenarios.when: Factorial and tree fold are routed through a candidate native realization of the same Sherlock reference machine.
scenarios.then: The inventory names dispatch, scalar, frame and data constraint owners, whether the realization is universal, per-program or a finite family, its common bounded StepInput/StepOutput interface and the native recursion/custom-decider adapter; complete semantic StepRecord snapshots are produced separately by host materializeStep. No VerifyProof or ledger10 prerequisite is introduced.

expected.inventory: names dispatch, scalar, frame and data constraint owners; universal vs per-program vs finite family; common StepInput/StepOutput interface; native recursion/custom-decider adapter

scenarios.blocker: needs a native relation inventory report naming dispatch/scalar/frame/data constraint owners and the recursion/custom-decider adapter for Factorial and tree fold

scenarios.name: Midnight stagenet end-to-end qualification
scenarios.when: Sherlock/Moriarty native target behavior is submitted for acceptance.
scenarios.then: The evidence includes actual supported source compilation, proof production and independent verification, Midnight stagenet deployment and call, and complete state/effects readback against independent expectations under pinned network/toolchain/relation identities. Unperformed stages stay not run; this scenario grants no execution authority or transfer of Preview/Fenrir evidence.

expected.evidence: source compilation, proof production and independent verification, stagenet deployment and call, state/effects readback against independent expectations under pinned identities

scenarios.blocker: needs the Midnight stagenet end-to-end qualification harness (compile, prove, independent verify, deploy, call, readback); stagenet is out of scope for this run
